V1_MINIMAL_VERIFIER_CORRECTION.feedback: Only sanitized native verdict class (WA/TLE/RE/CE_OR_TIMEOUT/FAIL). No hidden input, expected output, failing case, stack trace derived from hidden input, or hidden test content.
V1_MINIMAL_VERIFIER_CORRECTION.prompt_template: Your previous Python submission failed the hidden native verifier with verdict <VERDICT>. You are not given hidden tests or expected outputs. Re-read the original problem and inspect your previous code. Return one corrected Python 3 program only; no Markdown, explanation, or prose.

W0_DIRECT.prompt_prefix: Solve the programming problem below. Return only valid Python 3 source code. No Markdown fences, explanation, or prose.

claim_boundary: This tests a selective verifier/correction donor policy, not another prompt scaffold.
EBRC/Verifier Contract Gate receives zero cognitive-lift credit.
Instrument mismatch is quarantine, not model failure.
No result from this smoke alone supports a universal self-correction claim.

decision_rule.candidate_positive: At least one valid prospective W0-fail -> V1-pass rescue, no selective-policy harm, and no material cost veto.
decision_rule.null_or_harm: Reject/demote this donor; do not add prompt/architecture complexity to escape the result.
decision_rule.positive_smoke: CONDITIONAL only; requires a fresh confirmatory replication before promotion.

protocol: Fetch direct upstream AtCoder English statement sections only: Problem Statement, Constraints, Input, Output.
Run the frozen Verifier Contract Gate before model generation; quarantine incompatible instruments symmetrically.
Generate W0 direct for admitted tasks with exact pinned model/backend/decode.
Freeze and upload all W0 raw/code outputs before any hidden scoring.
Run pinned native hidden verifier and emit only sanitized verdict classes/counts.
Only admitted W0 failures receive one V1 minimal verifier-conditioned correction.
Fresh native re-verification of V1 code.
Report paired rescues, harms under the selective policy, unchanged failures, invalid/quarantined denominator, completion-token delta and generation-runtime delta.
purpose: Prospective weak/open-model test of a materially different donor family: executable native verifier signal followed by at most one minimal verifier-conditioned correction, compared with direct W0.

sample_freeze.population: EvoAgentBench code_implementation held-out test IDs beginning with abc, excluding every abc task ID found anywhere in the cold-start evidence archive, including nested historical ZIPs.
sample_freeze.selection: 6 smallest SHA256(epoch + ':' + task_id) among eligible IDs

verifier_contract_gate.admission: Only tasks with NO_MISMATCH_DETECTED under the frozen contract gate may enter W0 scoring.
verifier_contract_gate.property_or_special_judge: If output validity is defined by a feasibility/property condition rather than one unique reference value and the pinned generic LCB stdio verifier cannot represent that semantics, QUARANTINE.
